summary: Phase 2 testing complete. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed against the external URL covering (a) Accommodation rooms/assignments/occupancy — verified occupancy_rooms and assigned counters increment on POST and decrement on DELETE, plus 404 for missing room and 400 when neither team nor participant supplied; (b) Public Team Portal — /api/public/teams/1 returns nested coaches/participants/accommodation(room 001/Hostel Block A/Ground Floor)/transport/schedule, does NOT leak contact_email/contact_phone/notes, and returns 404 for missing team; (c) Knowledge comments POST/GET(ordered)/DELETE with 404 on missing knowledge item; (d) Documents LINK create/list/delete plus 400 when neither file nor url supplied, and download-on-link returns 404; (e) Document FILE upload with a real text file — file_name/content_type/size_bytes persisted, download returns exact bytes with correct filename in Content-Disposition, DELETE removes both DB row and file (download 404 after). Frontend Playwright: Admin /admin/accommodation renders 3 occupancy cards, native team/room selects populated, Assign flow creates a new row (id observed = 3, toast 'Room assigned' shown, occupancy card counter updated from 1 to 2 assignments); Public /teams team-card-1 navigates to /teams/1, team-portal renders Coach/Accommodation (Room 001 / Hostel Block A / Ground Floor)/Transport/Schedule/Team Members sections and share-team-btn is present; /teams/999999 shows team-portal-notfound. Admin /admin/knowledge details-knowledge-1 opens knowledge-detail dialog, comment added via comment-input + add-comment-btn appeared in knowledge-comments, LINK attachment added via doc-title-input + doc-url-input + add-document-btn appeared in knowledge-documents with an open-document-{id} link.

issues: Occupancy cards show a thin colored bar but no shadcn <Progress> component with aria role — progressbar role not found in DOM. Visual only; not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: attachments.py: POST /api/documents does not validate that external_url is an actual URL (no pydantic HttpUrl / regex). A user could store arbitrary text as external_url.

attachments.py: file uploads have no size limit or content-type allowlist — a malicious client can upload arbitrarily large files to /app/backend/uploads. Add MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES and stream-write with a running counter, or use FastAPI dependency to reject early.

attachments.py: filename is preserved verbatim in Content-Disposition — path traversal in filename is prevented by uuid-based storage_path, but titles/filenames should still be sanitized before echoing back to responses/headers to avoid response-splitting on odd bytes.

accommodation.py: no uniqueness constraint / duplicate-guard on (room_id, team_id) — a team can be assigned to the same room multiple times (observed 2 rows for team 1 in room 001 during UI test). Consider a DB unique index or 409 on duplicate.
accommodation.py: no capacity guard — assignments can exceed room.capacity silently (occupied can go above capacity in the response).
public.py: public_team_detail is not response_model-typed; correct fields are excluded by hand. Safer to define a TeamPortalPublic pydantic model so a future field on Team never accidentally leaks.

models.Comment has no explicit created_at/updated_at (it does inherit TimestampMixin — verified OK), but Comment lacks a length constraint on body — consider Text with a server-side max length to prevent abuse in a public/no-auth setup.
No auth on any of the new admin routes (documents upload, assignments, comments) — consistent with Phase 1 but should be gated before go-live; anyone with the public URL can upload files to disk.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and self-cleanup TEST_* rows (comment, link doc, uploaded file, accommodation assignment). UI test's transient assignment id=3 was cleaned via API DELETE after the UI run. Final state matches pre-test.
